cause_fact: Docker journal: gateway start could not attach its interface to docker0 because docker0 did not exist.
cause_reproduction: A dockerd with separate data-root but shared network namespace and --bridge=none deleted a marker docker0 in an isolated namespace.
cause_assessment: The restoration-test daemon interfered with the host network; this is a management-induced environment failure, not a candidate application failure.
repair: Restored docker0 from the existing network configuration (172.17.0.1/16); unauthenticated TCP connectivity to api.openai.com:443 passed. Future restoration daemons require unshare --net.
native_usage_missing_reason: Worker was never created; original package records missing native-usage.json.
elapsed_seconds_caveat: The fallback manifest elapsed_seconds measures fallback finalization, not implementation or full gateway setup time.
next_action: Implementation remains stopped. Corrected free restoration drill passed; any new acquisition requires user-authorized new Run IDs and scope.
